'''Ilox''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] who lived on the sprawling city [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], working as a [[Private investigator/Legends|private investigator]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he reported to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that a number of Republic officers disappeared after visiting [[Club Ufora]]. The back room contained a large amount of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] crates as well as armed guards and men.
